sites.enforcement_snippet:
if job.state != "queued":
    raise IllegalJobStateError(f"Job {job.id} cannot be started from state {job.state}")

domain_notes: start_job transitions a job to 'running' only from 'queued', guarded by a single state check. Both existing tests start jobs already in state 'queued'; neither starts a 'running' or 'completed' job, so the rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected start_job because its queued-state check is the sole enforcement and no test starts a non-queued job.
